entry.name: mc.interleave~
entry.digest: Interleave two or more multichannel signals
entry.description: The mc.interleave~ object combines two or more multichannel signals into a single multichannel signal by interleaving channels. This is useful for re-combining stereo pairs from MC sample playback objects prior to sending to mc.mixdown~ or mc.stereo~.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: The output multichannel signal will combine two or more input signals by using channels from each inlet in order from left to right. For example, if there are two inputs A and B with four channels each, the output will have eight channels consisting of A1, B1, A2, B2, A3, B3, A4, and B4.
